clauses.title: Every constraint is restated in the invocation payload
requires: inheritSkills: false
Invocation payload
Nothing may rely on a child inheriting this skill
### Run-invariant payload blocks (CL-D2, CL-D29)
#### Every-gate invariant payload block (CL-D2)
MERGE | FIX BEFORE MERGE | NEEDS DECISION
The formal gate child is read-only
#### Volatile envelope and compact history projection
include each applicable block verbatim in every applicable invocation
acceptance criteria the target must satisfy
full finding records only for unresolved findings and settled findings reopened by materially new evidence
stable finding ID, source gate, raised-against identity or fingerprint, disposition, confirmation gate or evidence
counts grouped by settled disposition
does not reduce the transmitted size of any invariant block
re-raising one requires materially new evidence
out-of-scope improvement rather than a blocker

clauses.title: Issue gate role authority is defined once in the Issue root
requires: Copy exactly one of these owning-root blocks verbatim into each Issue gate payload
Issue Sol role-authority block
read-only Issue requirements, contract, scope, acceptance, and feasibility reviewer
Issue Terra role-authority block
read-only inherited-decision, contradiction, and decision-drift reviewer for this Issue

clauses.title: PR gate role authority is defined once in the PR root
requires: Copy exactly one of these owning-root blocks verbatim into each PR gate payload
PR Sol role-authority block
read-only PR requirements, contract, scope, correctness, and test reviewer
PR Terra role-authority block
read-only concurrency, lifetime, ownership, cleanup, and decision-drift reviewer for this PR
